\section{Model}
We consider a chain of $N$ qubits evolving under a noisy circuit. The reduced density matrix obeys a master equation whose generator we write down explicitly in what follows, as in many earlier works on the subject of open quantum systems.
\begin{equation}
\frac{d\rho}{dt} = -i[H,\rho] + \sum_k \gamma_k \left( L_k \rho L_k^\dagger - \frac{1}{2}\{L_k^\dagger L_k, \rho\} \right)
\label{eq:lindblad}
\end{equation}
Here $H$ is the Hamiltonian and $L_k$ are jump operators. The rates $\gamma_k$ are positive, which guarantees complete positivity of the map generated by Eq.~(1). We now expand the Hamiltonian in Pauli strings, see (1).
\begin{align}
H &= \sum_{j} J_j Z_j Z_{j+1} + h \sum_j X_j, \\
E &= \langle \psi | H | \psi \rangle .
\end{align}
The energy in Eq.~(3) is bounded. We also need the entropy of a subsystem, defined by
\begin{equation}
S_A = -\mathrm{Tr}\, \rho_A \log \rho_A .
\end{equation}
